description: This file is a browser-based plugin interface for the TinyMCE rich text editor, providing UI elements for configuring 'abbr' (abbreviation) elements with attributes and event handlers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called on page load to set up the widget.

methods.name: insertAbbr
methods.description: Function invoked to insert or update the abbreviation element with user-provided attributes.

methods.name: removeAbbr
methods.description: Function to remove the abbreviation element from the editor.
